description: For every finite arity \(n\), including \(n=0\), a partial function \(f\) is partial recursive if and only if some arithmetic machine \(M\) satisfies \(f(\bar x)\simeq f_M(E_n(\bar x))\) for every input tuple.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.finite_arity_machine_iff {n : ℕ}
  {f : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.PFunction n} :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Recursive f ↔
    ∃ M,
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.Primitive M ∧
        ∀ (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args n),
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.compute M
              (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.tuplePack v) =
            f v
